fields.name: interaction_ready
fields.meaning: Current-state E can request quest collection, unopened shortcut activation, or return with quest and warmth conditions met

rules: Enabled only by environment.interaction_ready=true in grid MansionEnv experiments
Terminal snapshots encode 0; nonterminal external truncation retains state-derived readiness
Exit branch takes priority over quest and shortcut branches, matching GameCore
Derived from current state; does not predict success after damage or time processing
Action availability, game transitions, reward and termination are unchanged
Base grid 620 is unchanged; realtime observations have a separately versioned contract
